Full reward presupposes answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 27%. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 108 identities means 108 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
